note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs bill-of-lading records (B/L 1003648 to Morocco 2026-02-25; B/L 9338145 to Nepal 2026-02-03), so this is not a 'declared only' case. Declared HS 180500 (cocoa powder) and 210690 (food preparations) do not match any observed shipment line; observed codes are 12129200 and 35019000 on exports and 11090000/13023990/35019000 on imports. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: recommend verdict accepted_hs_corrected with actual codes recorded. Registered address per ImportKey: Saraswati House, Plot No.17, First Floor, Road No. H-8, DLF City Phase- (Gurugram, Haryana) — state inferred from address only, not from a registry record.
